agent-native.notes: Use the image-generation capability already configured for the current agent.

openai-images-api.notes: Supply the current provider-supported image model ID at configuration time.

google-genai-api.notes: Supply the current provider-supported image model ID at configuration time.

stability-api.notes: Supply the current provider-supported image model ID at configuration time.

replicate-api.notes: Use a current model or version identifier supplied by the user.

fal-api.notes: Use a current model endpoint or identifier supplied by the user.

comfyui-http.notes: Use a user-approved local workflow or model identifier; never assume a local server exists.

custom-http.notes: Use only with an endpoint and authentication method the user has explicitly authorized.
